sentences.en: The computer terminals were lined up in one long row.
sentences.zh: 这些电脑终端排成了一长列。

sentences.en: We have to get him a wheelchair at the terminal.
sentences.zh: 我们必须在航站楼给他安排一辆轮椅。

sentences.en: Sami was sitting in the terminal, waiting for his flight.
sentences.zh: 萨米坐在航站楼里等待他的航班。

senses.zh: 末端的；终点的；晚期的 Terminal终端，终端设备(仿真程序)，端子；终结符(T,TERM)
